title: decision-model-operator Helm values
description: Schema for the decision-model-operator chart values. Helm validates values against this on install/upgrade/template, so a typo in a known section fails fast.

tag.description: Manager image tag. Empty defaults to v<Chart.appVersion>.

pullPolicy.description: Image pull policy for the manager container.

imagePullSecrets.description: Secrets for pulling the manager image.

replicaCount.description: Number of controller-manager replicas (leader election picks one active).

resources.description: Resource requests/limits for the manager container (Kubernetes ResourceRequirements).

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for the manager Pod.

leaderElection.description: Enable leader election (recommended for HA / replicaCount > 1).

enabled.description: Expose the metrics endpoint and create a metrics Service (8443/HTTPS).

bindAddress.description: Address the metrics server binds to (e.g. ":8443").

serviceMonitor.description: Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor for the metrics Service.

enabled.description: Create a ServiceMonitor (requires metrics.enabled and the Prometheus Operator CRDs).

namespace.description: Namespace for the ServiceMonitor (empty = release namespace).

tlsVerify.description: Verify the metrics server certificate (needs a cert-manager cert + tlsServerName/caSecret).

caSecret.description: Secret holding ca.crt for tlsConfig.ca when tlsVerify is true.

allowedRegistries.description: --allowed-registries: comma-separated registry hosts a spec.model may resolve from (SSRF guard).

allowImageOverride.description: --allow-image-override: permit spec.image to override the engine default image.

ollayaRegistry.description: --ollaya-registry: default registry base URL for host-less model names. Empty = operator default. When set, must be an http:// or https:// URL.

ollayaHFEndpoint.description: --ollaya-hf-endpoint: base URL for model-weight downloads. Empty = runtime default. When set, must be an http:// or https:// URL.

runtimeVersionPolicy.description: --runtime-version-policy: how an unset spec.runtimeVersion resolves. Empty = binary default (Pinned).

maxConcurrentRollouts.description: --max-concurrent-rollouts: cap on simultaneous rollouts (0 = unlimited). null/unset = binary default (0).

proxy.description: HTTP(S) proxy for the operator's egress to the model registry.

httpProxy.description: HTTP_PROXY for the manager (and the prefetch Job). Empty = not set.

httpsProxy.description: HTTPS_PROXY for the manager (and the prefetch Job). Empty = not set.

noProxy.description: NO_PROXY for the manager (and the prefetch Job). Empty = not set.

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing Secret to source the proxy URLs from. Empty = use the plaintext values.

installCRDs.description: Install the CRD via Helm's crds/ dir.

prometheusRule.description: Prometheus alerting rules (PrometheusRule CR; requires the Prometheus Operator).

enabled.description: Create a PrometheusRule with the operator's alerting rules.

namespace.description: Namespace for the PrometheusRule (empty = release namespace).

labels.description: Extra labels on the PrometheusRule (e.g. the release label your Prometheus selects on).

runbookUrl.description: Base URL prepended to each alert's runbook_url annotation. When set, must be an http:// or https:// URL.

grafanaDashboard.description: Grafana dashboard shipped as a sidecar-discovered ConfigMap.

enabled.description: Create a ConfigMap holding the operator Grafana dashboard (labelled grafana_dashboard: "1").

namespace.description: Namespace for the dashboard ConfigMap (empty = release namespace).

labels.description: Extra labels on the dashboard ConfigMap (the sidecar label grafana_dashboard: "1" is always added).

folder.description: Grafana sidecar target-directory annotation; empty = sidecar default.
